label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: What a thing attains always or for the most part, it…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quinta via: unde patet quod non a casu
interpretation: The always-or-for-the-most-part regularity excludes chance, following Aristotle (Physics II.5; II.8, 198b34-199a3), where chance concerns what happens rarely.
